passages.text: While Israel was staying in Shittim, the men began to indulge in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab, who also invited them to the sacrifices for their gods. And the people ate and bowed down to these gods.
passages.sermon:
Israel stayed in Shittim.
The people of Israel lived there.
The men of Israel began to commit sexual immorality.
They sinned with the daughters of Moab.
The daughters of Moab invited the men of Israel.
They invited them to sacrifices for their gods.
The people of Israel ate at these sacrifices.
The people of Israel bowed down to the gods of Moab.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּשִּׁטִּ֑ים וַיָּ֣חֶל הָעָ֔ם לִזְנ֖וֹת אֶל־ בְּנ֥וֹת מוֹאָֽב׃ וַתִּקְרֶ֣אןָ לָעָ֔ם לְזִבְחֵ֖י אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ן וַיֹּ֣אכַל הָעָ֔ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲוּ֖וּ לֵֽאלֹהֵיהֶֽן׃

passages.text: So Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor, and the anger of the LORD burned against them.
passages.sermon:
Israel was the people God chose.
Israel joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.
Baal of Peor was a false god.
The LORD saw what Israel did.
The LORD became very angry with Israel.
passages.original: וַיִּצָּ֥מֶד יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֥ף יְהוָ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take all the leaders of the people and execute them in broad daylight before the LORD, so that His fierce anger may turn away from Israel.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD said, "Take all the leaders of the people."
The leaders are the heads of Israel.
Execute these leaders.
Do this in broad daylight.
Do this before the LORD.
This will turn away the LORD’s fierce anger from Israel.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה קַ֚ח אֶת־ כָּל־ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָעָ֔ם וְהוֹקַ֥ע אוֹתָ֛ם לַיהוָ֖ה נֶ֣גֶד הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ וְיָשֹׁ֛ב חֲר֥וֹן אַף־ יְהוָ֖ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: So Moses told the judges of Israel, “Each of you must kill all of his men who have joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.”
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of Israel.
Moses spoke to the judges of Israel.
Moses gave a command to the judges.
He said, "Each judge must kill his own men."
These men had joined in worshiping Baal of Peor.
Baal of Peor was a false god.
The men had turned away from the LORD.
Moses ordered the judges to punish them with death.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֶל־ שֹׁפְטֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הִרְגוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֲנָשָׁ֔יו הַנִּצְמָדִ֖ים לְבַ֥עַל פְּעֽוֹר׃

passages.text: Just then an Israelite man brought to his family a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses and the whole congregation of Israel while they were weeping at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
passages.sermon:
An Israelite man came.
He brought a Midianite woman to his family.
Moses saw this.
All the congregation of Israel saw this.
They were at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
They were weeping there.
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֡ה אִישׁ֩ מִבְּנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל בָּ֗א וַיַּקְרֵ֤ב אֶל־ אֶחָיו֙ אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית לְעֵינֵ֣י מֹשֶׁ֔ה וּלְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהֵ֣מָּה בֹכִ֔ים פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

passages.text: On seeing this, Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, got up from the assembly, took a spear in his hand, followed the Israelite into his tent, and drove the spear through both of them—through the Israelite and on through the belly of the woman. So the plague against the Israelites was halted, but those who died in the plague numbered 24,000.
passages.sermon:
Phinehas was the son of Eleazar.  
Eleazar was the son of Aaron the priest.  
Phinehas saw what happened.  
He stood up from the assembly.  
He took a spear in his hand.  
He followed the Israelite man into the tent.  
He pierced both the Israelite man and the woman with the spear.  
He struck the man and the woman through her belly.  
The plague against the Israelites stopped.  
Twenty-four thousand Israelites died in the plague.
passages.original: וַיַּ֗רְא פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וַיָּ֙קָם֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הָֽעֵדָ֔ה וַיִּקַּ֥ח רֹ֖מַח בְּיָדֽוֹ׃ וַ֠יָּבֹא אַחַ֨ר אִֽישׁ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶל־ הַקֻּבָּ֗ה וַיִּדְקֹר֙ אֶת־ שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם אֵ֚ת אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה אֶל־ קֳבָתָ֑הּ וַתֵּֽעָצַר֙ הַמַּגֵּפָ֔ה מֵעַ֖ל בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ וַיִּהְי֕וּ הַמֵּתִ֖ים בַּמַּגֵּפָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֥ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned My wrath away from the Israelites; for he was zealous for My sake among them, so that I did not consume the Israelites in My zeal.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
Phinehas is the son of Eleazar.
Eleazar is the son of Aaron the priest.
Phinehas turned away My wrath from the Israelites.
Phinehas was zealous for Me among them.
Because of this, I did not destroy the Israelites in My zeal.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ פִּֽינְחָ֨ס בֶּן־ אֶלְעָזָ֜ר בֶּן־ אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֗ן הֵשִׁ֤יב אֶת־ חֲמָתִי֙ מֵעַ֣ל בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּקַנְא֥וֹ אֶת־ קִנְאָתִ֖י בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְלֹא־ כִלִּ֥יתִי אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּקִנְאָתִֽי׃

passages.text: Declare, therefore, that I am granting him My covenant of peace.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God said to Moses, “Phinehas son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, acted with zeal for Me among the Israelites.
Phinehas turned away My anger from the Israelites.
Because of this, I did not destroy the Israelites in My zeal.
Therefore, say this:
I, the Lord, am giving Phinehas My covenant of peace.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֖ן אֱמֹ֑ר הִנְנִ֨י נֹתֵ֥ן ל֛וֹ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֖י שָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: It will be a covenant of permanent priesthood for him and his descendants, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the Israelites.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God described Phinehas.
Phinehas is the son of Eleazar.
Eleazar is the son of Aaron the priest.
God said He would give Phinehas a covenant.
This covenant is for Phinehas and his descendants after him.
This covenant is a covenant of permanent priesthood.
Phinehas was zealous for his God.
Phinehas made atonement for the Israelites.
God gave this covenant because of Phinehas’s zeal and atonement.
passages.original: וְהָ֤יְתָה לּוֹ֙ וּלְזַרְע֣וֹ אַחֲרָ֔יו בְּרִ֖ית כְּהֻנַּ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֤ר קִנֵּא֙ לֵֽאלֹהָ֔יו וַיְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: The name of the Israelite who was slain with the Midianite woman was Zimri son of Salu, the leader of a Simeonite family.
passages.sermon:
Zimri was an Israelite man.
Someone killed Zimri together with a Midianite woman.
Zimri was the son of Salu.
Zimri was a leader of a family from the tribe of Simeon.
passages.original: וְשֵׁם֩ אִ֨ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַמֻּכֶּ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֻכָּה֙ אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֔ית זִמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ סָל֑וּא נְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־ אָ֖ב לַשִּׁמְעֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: And the name of the slain Midianite woman was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur, a tribal chief of a Midianite family.
passages.sermon:
Cozbi was a woman from Midian.
Someone killed Cozbi.
Zur was Cozbi’s father.
Zur was a leader.
Zur led a family group in Midian.
Cozbi was the daughter of this leader.
passages.original: וְשֵׁ֨ם הָֽאִשָּׁ֧ה הַמֻּכָּ֛ה הַמִּדְיָנִ֖ית כָּזְבִּ֣י בַת־ צ֑וּר רֹ֣אשׁ אֻמּ֥וֹת בֵּֽית־ אָ֛ב בְּמִדְיָ֖ן הֽוּא׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Attack the Midianites and strike them dead.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Attack the Midianites.
Strike the Midianites dead.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ צָר֖וֹר אֶת־ הַמִּדְיָנִ֑ים וְהִכִּיתֶ֖ם אוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: For they assailed you deceitfully when they seduced you in the matter of Peor and their sister Cozbi, the daughter of the Midianite leader, the woman who was killed on the day the plague came because of Peor.”
passages.sermon:
The Midianites are your enemies.
They acted against you with deceit.
They deceived you in the matter of Peor.
They also deceived you through Cozbi.
Cozbi is the daughter of a Midianite leader.
She is their sister.
Someone killed Cozbi on the day the plague came.
The plague came because of the matter of Peor.
passages.original: כִּ֣י צֹרְרִ֥ים הֵם֙ לָכֶ֔ם בְּנִכְלֵיהֶ֛ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִכְּל֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּע֑וֹר וְעַל־ דְּבַ֞ר כָּזְבִּ֨י בַת־ נְשִׂ֤יא מִדְיָן֙ אֲחֹתָ֔ם הַמֻּכָּ֥ה בְיוֹם־ הַמַּגֵּפָ֖ה עַל־ דְּבַר־ פְּעֽוֹר׃
